comment: Thresholds fixed before any CAIS evidence was collected (docs/design/07 section 5.3). The statistical unit is the distinct task; confidence 0.9 one-sided Wilson lower bound. Only capabilities with an executable, versioned suite are defined; see docs/design/07 section 4.2 for the classes deliberately not defined yet.

coding.routine.description: Small, well-scoped repository changes (defect repair, refactor, spec implementation, security fix, migration, test generation) accepted only when hidden tests pass; engx base corpus, up to 3 attempts with test feedback.

coding.complex.description: Harder specification implementations, root-cause investigation, data migration and performance work accepted only when hidden tests pass; engx hard corpus, up to 3 attempts with test feedback.
